For more medical student works please visit the Warren Alpert Medical School Academic Symposium collection and tWarren Alpert Medical School Scholarly Concentrations Gallery of Scholarly Work collection.

collections.name: Africana Studies
collections.description: Located in the historic Churchill House on the campus of Brown University, the Department of Africana Studies is the intellectual center for faculty and students interested in the artistic, historical, literary, and theoretical expressions of the various cultures of Africa and the African Diaspora. Central to the intellectual work of the department is the close collaboration of artists and scholars in examining relationships between academic and artistic knowledge about the world and human experience.
